payload.comment: Ingestion stage is consistent and complete. All split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match the official PathMNIST splits exactly; no subsampling was applied. The dataset manifest records archive MD5, per-split index SHA-256 hashes, a Zenodo data reference, CC BY 4.0 license, 9 classes, 3 channels, and a multi-class task — all internally consistent. The run manifest pins code SHA-256, all package versions (torch 2.14.0+cu126, numpy 2.4.6, lightning 2.6.5, etc.), Python 3.11.15, seed 72, and deterministic_torch=true. Created_at (11:48:31) is 1.5 s before the authoritative UTC timestamp (11:48:32), which is expected. No omitted artifacts. Deterministic findings list is empty, confirming no hard errors. One minor reproducibility note: llm_model_digest is null for the qwen3.8 Ollama model, meaning the exact model weights are not pinned; if any downstream stage relies on LLM output, results could shift if the local model is updated. This does not block ingestion. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is a known dataset characteristic and is properly documented. Proceed to the next stage.
